title: runner_request/v1
description: Body of the harness's POST /decide to the agent (IC-6). A versioned wrapper (deviation from the dev-plan's bare '{observation}'): the single retry must carry the validator error WITHOUT perturbing the observation, whose hash must remain the hash of exactly what the agent saw; a wrapper is the only shape that does both. The observation inside attempt 2 is byte-identical to attempt 1; ObservationEmitted is logged once per turn. No auth headers, nothing secret ever transits this interface (local sandboxed network, SEC-1).

schema.description: Schema name and major version of this document.

attempt.description: 1 = first ask; 2 = the single retry after a parse/validation failure. Timeouts and transport errors are NEVER retried.

observation.description: The full IC-2 observation for this turn - exactly the object that was JCS-hashed for ObservationEmitted; byte-identical across both attempts.

anyOf.description: Populated only on attempt 2: what was wrong with attempt 1, verbatim.

reason.description: The ActionRejected reason code from attempt 1 (e.g. 'float_target', 'invalid_json').

detail.description: The exact validator diagnostic from attempt 1, e.g. 'target.BTC is a JSON number with a fractional part; send a decimal STRING with <= 4 fraction digits, e.g. "1.5"'. Fed back verbatim so the agent can self-correct in one round trip.

prior_raw_sha256.description: Content address of the malformed attempt-1 output, for agent-side correlation.

retry.description: Retry feedback channel: null on attempt 1, the attempt-1 validator error on attempt 2.
